full_judgment: 12. In the result, the rule is made absolute. The judgment and order passed by the learned S.C.C. Judge is set aside and S.C.C. Suit No 7 of 1972 is hereby decreed. The plaintiff petitioner will get khas possession of the suit premises by evicting the defendant in according with law, Let the schedule of the plaint be amended, as prayed for in the petition. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, there will be no order as to costs.
